sloka: अवजित्य जित क्रोधस् तम् अचिन्त्य पराक्रमः ।रावणम् समरे हत्वा भर्ता त्वा अधिगमिष्यति ।। ६-३३-३१।।
transliteration: avajitya jita krodhas tam acintya parākramaḥ ।rāvaṇam samare hatvā bhartā tvā adhigamiṣyati ।। 6-33-31।।

translations.english: "Your fire of anger will be gone. Your husband, the lotuspetal eyed Rama whose prowess is inconceivable like that of Indra who vanquished Daityas will come and kill Ravana and win you back."
